english.title: Drive on a road a motor vehicle subject of a prohibition order under s. 69 of the Road Traffic Act 1988
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), in contravention of a prohibition notice issued on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF ISSUE / COMMENCEMENT..) under section 69 of the Road Traffic Act 1988
english.legislation: Contrary to Section 71(1)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 3 Road Vehicles (Prohibition) Regulations 1992 for exemptions.
(ii) See also offence wording H3969 and H3971 for the cause and permit variations.
(iii) See offence wording H2994 for failing to comply with a direction to remove the vehicle within a reasonable time contrary to section 71(1)(c) Road Traffic Act 1988.
(iv) Each prohibition should be charged separately. An inspection under section 69 covers vehicles as given in sections 41, 45, 49, 61, 67, 68 or 77 of the Road Traffic Act 1988.
(v) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), in contravention of a prohibition order issued under section 69 of the Road Traffic Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Three hundred pounds.
Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
